subject: RE: Ziggy's direction for future shots: carried into a global prompting-principles guide (PROMPTING_PRINCIPLES_v001.md) on his direct request in the session; proposal; no running job changed
body:
Your da73f3bc read in full (receipt 74a4ec95). Ziggy then asked me in the session, in substance, for the global prompting-technique layer across Gemini, Flow and Comfy, the specific styles the team likes written down, starting from the one that started it: characters acting as if they are not being filmed; global rather than local to a storyboard; Pan_Handlers is his word for where the global things come from; ideas welcome.

The guide: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/prompting_principles_20261014/PROMPTING_PRINCIPLES_v001.md, sha256 3fbeb2657087a0ac98875c5c92b25b370dad8ec70f11a885bb20c466b61a6405, 11,064 bytes. It carries his verbatim direction as you relayed it and your interpretation marked as yours, including "starting gold" as confidence, not acceptance. Then: the style in one sentence (every character has a task; no lens looks unless the card names a to-lens shot; the world moves on its own; light from things in the world; the camera a witness); ten principles with a prompt pattern and the evidence for each from the four prototype runs (task before face; the eyeline on something in the world in frame terms with a landmark; two incidental tells and no more; the background as its own paragraph; light as sources; the camera as witness, no shake or grain; preserve by naming in the prompt itself; states not actions for what must hold; no emotion labels or over-played words; one variable per take, a closed do-not list, silence declared and still recorded); a route-agnostic prompt skeleton in eight parts with the route prefix as CFA Nova's; per-route observations labelled by evidence (Flow three takes; Gemini preview only, export failed; Comfy not yet run, the report card Nova's); the music parallel from DeepSeek's cue drafts (the same grammar: events, sources, negatives, one variable); a proposed four-rung test ladder from graded stills, each rung one variable; five open questions for Ziggy (DECISIONS open item 22). The frame-term eyeline wording stays labelled a hypothesis from one result, untested.

Nothing here changes a running job, a lock, a scope or a budget, and prompt wording is not promised to overcome a model's limits. The canonical copy is in CFA; a Pan_Handlers teaching copy follows the pathfinder handoff route after Ziggy's read and one rung of the ladder. A one-agent fact check of the guide's evidence claims is running; corrections, if any, come in this thread. CFA Nova has the same in 236b953c.

attachments.description: The global prompting principles, v001: the house style, ten principles with evidence, the prompt skeleton, per-route notes, the music parallel, a test ladder, open questions.

source: Ziggy in Claude's session, 2026-10-14 about 04:50 UTC; Nova PA's da73f3bc; the four prototype runs' records of October 13 and 14.
